description.zh: 该参数用于保证请求的幂等性。由客户端生成该参数值，保证在不同请求间该参数值的唯一性。该参数区分大小写、长度不超过64个ASCII字符。
description.en: A client token to ensure the idempotence of the request. Generate a unique token for each request. The token is case-sensitive and can be up to 64 ASCII characters in length.
The information about the nodes to upgrade or add.

description.zh:
升配/新增节点的规格。

> - 新增节点时，节点规格需要与原有节点规格保持一致。
> - 原有集群节点规格请参见[DescribeDBClusters](~~98094~~)。
description.en:
The specifications of the node to upgrade or add.

> - When you add a node, the node specifications must be the same as the specifications of the existing nodes.
>
> - For more information about the specifications of existing cluster nodes, see [DescribeDBClusters](~~98094~~).

description.zh: 新增节点的可用区。需要与原有节点保持一致。
description.en: The zone for the new node. The zone must be the same as the zone of the existing nodes.

description.zh: 变更类型。当前取值固定为**TempUpgrade**。
description.en: The modification type. The value is fixed to **TempUpgrade**.

description.zh:
操作类型。取值：

- **Modify**：临时升配
- **Add**：临时加节点
description.en:
The operation type. Valid values:

- **Modify**: temporary upgrade

- **Add**: temporarily add a node

description.zh:
临时升配还原时间。格式为YYYY-MM-DD hh:mm:ss。

> 还原时间不能早于当前时间往后推1小时，不能晚于集群到期时间的前1天。
description.en:
The time to revert the temporary upgrade. The format is YYYY-MM-DD hh:mm:ss.

> The revert time must be at least 1 hour later than the current time. It must also be at least 1 day before the cluster expires.

title.zh: 为集群临时升配或增加节点

example.unifiedCli: aliyun polardb temp-modify-db-node --client-token 6000170000591aed949d0f500000000000000000000 --db-cluster-id pc-xxxxxxxxxx --operation-type Modify --modify-type TempUpgrade --db-node ZoneId=cn-hangzhou-i TargetClass=polar.mysql.x4.medium --restore-time 2021-09-23_18:16:00 --auto-use-coupon true --promotion-code 727xxxxxx934 --region cn-hangzhou
